native.hook: 疑问句里，are 要放在 you 前面！
native.tip: 中文“你为什么迟到”语序不变，英语疑问句要把 are 提到 you 前面。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “Why you are late?”😅 中文问“你为什么迟到了”，语序和陈述句一样；英语的疑问句要把 are 放到 you 前面：“Why are you late?”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“Why are you late?”免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: In an English question, put are before you.
en.caption: Do you say “Why you are late?” 😅 In an English question, put are before you: “Why are you late?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.

in.why: Want is followed by to.
in.answer_say: To drink! I want to drink more water.

native.tip: 中文“我想回家”中间不需要别的词，英语里 want 后面接动词要加 to。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I want go home.”😅 中文说“我想回家”，“想”后面直接接动词；英语里 want 后面的动词前要加 to：“I want to go home.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“I want to go home.”免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: After want, use to before a verb.
en.caption: Do you say “I want go home.” 😅 After want, use to before another verb: “I want to go home.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.

in.hook_say: Say most people, not most of!
in.why: Before a plain noun, say most.
in.answer_say: Most! Most students like games.

native.tip: “大多数”后面直接接名词时，用 most，不加 of：most people。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “Most of people like tea.”😅 “大多数人”后面直接接名词，英语不加 of：“Most people like tea.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“Most people like tea.”免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Before a plain noun, say most, with no of.
en.caption: Do you say “Most of people like tea.” 😅 Before a plain noun, say most with no of: “Most people like tea.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.

in.why: Say there are, not there have.
in.answer_say: Are! There are many cars.

native.hook: “这里有很多人”不是 There have！
native.tip: 中文“有”既表示拥有也表示存在；说“某处有……”要用 there is/are，不用 have。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “There have many people here.”😅 中文的“有”也表示存在，但英语说“某处有……”要用 there is/are：“There are many people here.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“There are many people here.”免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: To say something exists, use there is or there are, not have.
en.caption: Do you say “There have many people here.” 😅 To say something exists, use there are: “There are many people here.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.

in.hook_say: Use although or but, not both!
in.wrong: Although I am tired, but I keep working.
in.right: Although I am tired, I keep working.
in.why: Use although or but, not both.
in.answer_say: We! Although it was late, we stayed.

native.hook: although 和 but 只能留一个！
native.tip: 中文“虽然……但是……”常常连用，英语里 although 和 but 不能在同一句里搭配使用，只留一个。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “Although I am tired, but I keep working.”😅 中文可以说“虽然我很累，但是我还要继续工作”，英语里 although 和 but 只能用一个：“Although I am tired, I keep working.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“Although I am tired, I keep working.”免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: In English, use although or but in one sentence, not both.
en.caption: Do you say “Although I am tired, but I keep working.” 😅 In English, use although or but, not both: “Although I am tired, I keep working.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
